name: Nexus-TH thermometer and hygrometer
description: A very common cheap outdoor temperature and humidity sensor, sold under many names (Nexus, FreeTec NC-7345, Clas Ohlson TW003/TW007, Digoo and others). The transmitter sends 36 bits twelve times in a row, separated by a long gap. The pulse is always the same length and the gap carries the data, so this is PPM: a short gap is a zero and a double-length gap is a one. There is no checksum at all; the only integrity check available is the constant nibble 0xF before the humidity and the fact that the frame is repeated a dozen times, which is why the decoder insists on seeing the same frame twice.
